tooling: Triage against the generated Zephyr .config and source call sites

statements.impact_statement: The TLS library is not built into this firmware; the serialized SSL session code is absent. Evidence: # CONFIG_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY is not set; TLS 1.2/1.3 versions are not set. Configuration inherited from the Zephyr 4.1.0 mbedtls Kconfig profile (zephyr@80de0ea4045869967c6b8e3d86b761955b1c981b); generated .config export sha256 6e75f5e5dd99480a8679106b91646c229dcec62d0a4a5dfad4b4d3bb2e14496f.

Finite-field Diffie-Hellman is not compiled; Matter uses PASE/CASE over P-256. Evidence: # CONFIG_MBEDTLS_DHM_C is not set. Configuration inherited from the Zephyr 4.1.0 mbedtls Kconfig profile (zephyr@80de0ea4045869967c6b8e3d86b761955b1c981b); generated .config export sha256 6e75f5e5dd99480a8679106b91646c229dcec62d0a4a5dfad4b4d3bb2e14496f.

X.509 CSR writing is compiled but has no call site in the Telink platform or the application; the only CSR call sites in the tree are the Infineon and NXP fallbacks. Evidence: symbols present in zephyr.elf, but no mbedtls_x509write_csr call sites in src/platform/telink or examples. Configuration inherited from the Zephyr 4.1.0 mbedtls Kconfig profile (zephyr@80de0ea4045869967c6b8e3d86b761955b1c981b); generated .config export sha256 6e75f5e5dd99480a8679106b91646c229dcec62d0a4a5dfad4b4d3bb2e14496f.

Same call graph as CVE-2025-47917: no X.509 name construction at runtime. Evidence: symbols present in zephyr.elf, no runtime caller. Configuration inherited from the Zephyr 4.1.0 mbedtls Kconfig profile (zephyr@80de0ea4045869967c6b8e3d86b761955b1c981b); generated .config export sha256 6e75f5e5dd99480a8679106b91646c229dcec62d0a4a5dfad4b4d3bb2e14496f.

AESNI is an x86-only feature; the RISC-V build does not contain that code. Evidence: riscv64 build; no MBEDTLS_AESNI_C in the configuration. Configuration inherited from the Zephyr 4.1.0 mbedtls Kconfig profile (zephyr@80de0ea4045869967c6b8e3d86b761955b1c981b); generated .config export sha256 6e75f5e5dd99480a8679106b91646c229dcec62d0a4a5dfad4b4d3bb2e14496f.

statements.action_statement: Upgrade Mbed TLS to 3.6.6 or backport the PRNG seed fix; track as a release blocker. Longer term: Zephyr 4.4 ships Mbed TLS 4.1.0, which is outside the affected range of every CVE in this report. The upgrade requires a tl_zephyr port for Zephyr 4.4 (no such branch exists in the Telink fork yet) and a fresh configuration export, because the mbedtls profile may change with the major version.
